meta.name: The Resurrected
meta.description:
Two grieving mothers resurrect a scam ringleader to avenge their daughters — but as painful truths emerge, justice slips from their reach.

Complete series. On your server: S1 9/9

videos.title: Execution Day
videos.overview: One daughter is dead, the other in a coma. As a public trial looms, Hui-chun and Chao Ching travel to a remote village in search of a resurrection rite.

videos.title: Resurrection Day
videos.overview: Following scam leader Chang Shih-kai's sentencing, the mothers act fast to secure what's needed for the ritual, using blackmail to fund their next move.

videos.title: Vengeance Day
videos.overview: As Hui-chun and Chao Ching continue their plan, disturbing details about Paradise Hotel begin to surface, shedding light on what their daughters endured.

videos.title: Investigation Day
videos.overview: While Chao Ching interrogates Chang Shih-kai and uncovers his ties to a religious group, Hui-chun attends his vigil at a temple tied to his past.

videos.title: Investigation Night
videos.overview: At a public speaking event, An Chi shares her past at Paradise Hotel. Meanwhile, the mothers set a new plan in motion as their scheme quietly expands.

videos.title: Day of Disarray
videos.overview: At the temple, Hui-chun shows Chang Shih-kai's mother a cryptic video that rattles her. Elsewhere, pharmacist Pong gets drawn into the investigation.

videos.title: Day of Rupture
videos.overview: During early police questioning, a link between Chang Shih-kai and Eason's grandmother surfaces. Later, Pong shares a concerning detail with Chao Ching.

videos.title: Judgement Day
videos.overview: As Chao Ching and lawyer Huang I-chen dig into the San Ching-tai Foundation for more answers, pressure builds around the idea of a second ritual.

videos.title: Judgement Night
videos.overview: The mothers near a breaking point when Chao Ching pushes for one last ritual. As tensions peak, the scam spirals — and the cost of revenge comes due.
